topic: Paper comes to the Muslim world: paper-making was learned in Samarkand after 751 CE, and Baghdad had its first paper mill around 794-795 CE. Books became cheaper and libraries grew. Show pulp, frames, drying sheets and a busy book market.

episode.title: Kaghaz Ka Safar: Samarkand Se Baghdad

shots.narration: ایک سادہ کاغذ نے کتابوں کی دنیا کیسے بدل دی؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D family animation. A Pakistani home with golden lamplight, an ordinary grandfather in a cream kurta and brown waistcoat beside a girl in yellow with a light-pink dupatta. A blank paper sheet rests on a low table. No visible writing.
shots.action: Nana raises the blank sheet toward Areeba.
shots.mood: Warm amber light, curious eyes, inviting mystery.

shots.narration: پہلے کتابیں مہنگی تھیں، زیادہ کاغذ سے وہ سستی ہوئیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, the same cozy home. One closed plain book sits beside a stack of plain books on a low wooden table; all covers are unmarked.
shots.action: Nana gestures from the single book toward the stack.
shots.mood: Gentle explanation, soft golden light, attentive expressions.

shots.narration: [excited] سمرقند میں 751 کے بعد کاغذ بنانا سیکھا گیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, stylized historic Samarkand with earthen courtyard buildings, brick arches, a garden and distant hills, warm 3D family animation. No people, signs or inscriptions.
shots.action: A courtyard tree sways in the breeze.

shots.narration: کاغذ بنانے کے لیے ریشوں کا گودا تیار ہوتا تھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of a shallow workshop basin containing pale fibrous pulp and water, with plain wooden tools nearby. No people or writing.
shots.action: Pale fibers swirl through the water.
shots.mood: Tactile detail, warm light, quiet fascination.

shots.narration: پھر جالی والے سانچے پر گودے کی تہہ بچھتی تھی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, back at the home demonstration table. Nana and Areeba sit beside a shallow basin and a small wooden mesh frame. Plain objects only, no writing.
shots.action: Nana lifts a pulp-covered mesh frame from the basin.
shots.mood: Patient teaching, sparkling droplets, warm family atmosphere.

shots.narration: [whispers] پانی نکلتا، تو جالی پر گیلی تہہ رہ جاتی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, macro view of the demonstration frame resting across the basin, with a thin even layer of pale pulp covering its mesh. No writing.
shots.action: Water drips from the underside of the frame.
shots.mood: Soft highlights on droplets, calm concentration.

shots.narration: یہ تہہ سوکھتی، تو کاغذ کی چادر بن جاتی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, historic workshop courtyard with blank paper sheets drying on smooth boards beneath a shaded brick arcade. No people, markings or inscriptions.
shots.action: A loose corner of a dry sheet lifts in the breeze.
shots.mood: Sunlit cream paper, gentle shadows, satisfying transformation.

shots.narration: بغداد میں تقریباً 794-795 میں کاغذ بنانے کا پہلا کارخانہ بنا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a modest historic Baghdad paper workshop courtyard with brick arches, pulp basins, mesh frames and drying boards. No people, machinery, signage or writing.
shots.action: A light breeze ripples blank sheets on a drying rack.
shots.mood: Warm afternoon light, orderly craft, quiet pride.

shots.narration: [excited] کاغذ بڑھا، تو کتابیں بنانا بھی سستا ہونے لگا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of abundant blank paper stacks beside several finished books with plain leather covers on a historic workshop bench. No lettering or symbols.
shots.action: The top blank sheet curls slightly in the breeze.
shots.mood: Rich paper textures, golden highlights, hopeful abundance.

shots.narration: کتابوں کے بازاروں میں زیادہ کتابیں دستیاب ہونے لگیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a richly stocked historic Baghdad book market lane, closely spaced stalls, overflowing plain-covered book stacks and colorful fabric awnings. The market is shown without people; no signs or writing.
shots.action: Fabric awnings flutter above the book stalls.
shots.mood: Lively colors, plentiful books, welcoming golden light.

shots.narration: کتابیں بڑھیں، تو کتب خانے بھی بڑے ہونے لگے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a spacious historic library with brick arches, many shelves of plain unmarked books, low reading desks and a garden visible beyond. No people or inscriptions.
shots.action: A sheer curtain billows beside the garden doorway.
shots.mood: Quiet wonder, long golden sunbeams, abundant knowledge.

shots.narration: [excited] پھر بغداد کے کتب خانوں میں علم کیسے پھیلا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, the cozy Pakistani home again. Nana sits beside Areeba at the low table, with their dried blank paper sheet beside a closed unmarked book.
shots.action: Areeba opens the book to blank pages.
shots.mood: Warm lamplight, eager curiosity, inviting anticipation.

episode.endHook: Baghdad ke kutub khanon mein ilm kaise phaila?
episode.description: نانا ابو اریبہ کو بتاتے ہیں کہ سمرقند میں 751 CE کے بعد کاغذ بنانا سیکھا گیا، اور بغداد میں تقریباً 794-795 CE میں پہلا کاغذ بنانے کا کارخانہ قائم ہوا۔ گودے سے تیار ہونے والے کاغذ نے کتابیں سستی کیں اور کتب خانوں کو بڑھنے میں مدد دی۔
